job.question: What time does a Saturday workshop begin?

context.text: Fictional Harbor Workshop manual. Receipt L-84 confirms that a booking form arrived. It does not confirm approval. Only a separate approval notice confirms an approved booking.
Saturday workshops begin at 09:30. Wednesday workshops begin at 18:15. The Wednesday time does not apply to Saturday workshops.
Participants may request an email copy of the handout; requesting it is optional. Every participant must bring a membership card.
Routine notes are kept for 30 days. Notes linked to an unresolved incident are kept for 90 days instead of 30 days.
The blue notice replaces the green notice for this month. The green notice lists Monday pickup. The blue notice lists Wednesday pickup.
Five practice kits were ordered. The first two kits are free. Each additional kit requires four workshop credits.
Rina gave Omar a notebook. Omar gave Rina a calendar. Rina did not give Omar the calendar.
The manual gives no birthplace or birth date for Rina and gives no information about the water resistance of any ticket.
